riff.note: An eight-bar riff of six bar shapes read off source 8: long low holds a semitone or three apart and one high hold every four bars that falls back; a near-pure sine at its source, played in the place's voice. A note is [step, length, semitones over home, 's' to slide in]. Each theme writes its own riff in the grammar: every non-home note may move to a neighbour in the vocabulary (moveP), one place at oneStepP or else two. articulation: how far under E1 a lower neighbour may reach, in semitones, and the seconds a marked slide and an ordinary change take; entrance: a low onset of its own on a run that starts on one of these steps after a rest (level, cents above the note, seconds). phrase: where the drops play, `bars` of held runs in place of the bar shapes. A run is one note from `step` for `len` sixteenths, its knots in sixteenths from its start: anchors [step, shape, note] or [step, "home"] are the notes its gestures belong to, a note of the theme's rolled shapes or home, held between two knots naming one note and travelled in a straight line between two naming two, each at its rolled interval over the line's home (home folded into the register once, as the line's notes are); pitch [step, semitones] is the gesture's own shape over that path (the falls, the flicks, the settling), the same on every theme; level [step, gain] is the note's output; pair [step, share] the voice's pair level as a share of its own; optional body [step, gain] scales its third harmonic without raising the fundamental. A kick inside a run marked press, while the run holds through the kick's duck, takes the low duck at pressDb. afterKick: where a run is still held, flat and without its pair, from the bar's kick on step through the snare on snare (its pair share at the snare under pairUnder, its path within flatSt of the snare's pitch for clearSteps after it and no rise over flatSt between the two), the line flicks up to flickSt over the higher of the note held into the kick and the snare's, peakSteps after the kick, back on the path fallSteps later, then sags at sagStPerStep to the run's next travel, at most sagMaxSt deep, lifted, never cut, over the register's floor less underFloorSt; its knobs are flickSt, sagStPerStep and sagMaxSt. knobs: the phrase's gestures as declared ranges, the written phrase at their defaults (a setting none yet writes; birds later): scoop scales every pitch knot's residual over its anchor path, afterKick's flick and sag with it, never the anchors (0: the anchors' plain path), swell every level knot's distance from 1 (0: flat), pairOnHold every pair share (0: no pair), edge every body knot's distance from 1 (0: no accent), pressDb the low duck a pressed kick asks. play: how the line is played — the lowest note (floor, MIDI; E1) and the most over the register's ceiling (ceilingOver, semitones); the accent on its steps (on) and elsewhere (off); the line stepping aside under each backbeat (dips: steps, dB, from earlyS seconds before); the release into the next run or the bar's end (touching) and into a rest (resting); a run that touches holds holdS seconds over, one that rests lets go at restShare of its length; a change takes at most changeShare of its gap; a phrase run ends phraseGapS before its length; outside the riff a note holds into the next where the gap is gapSteps or less (joined, of the onsets' distance) and else plays detached of its length, a slide in held slideOverS over the next onset. trimDb (on the phrase): the riff's level against V's in the same voice, in dB, on the gain of every note it plays.

provenance.source: the catalog's source 8, a drum and bass mix (mining id 8)
provenance.passage: 733.991-756.060 s of the source, 16 bars at 174 BPM; the phrase is its bars 1-8
provenance.reading: the bass line read with phase off the 22-120 Hz band of the mix: a dominant-peak and phase-slope pitch path, the main component demodulated along it (level and fine pitch), a pair partner tested in 0.6 s holds; the per-sixteenth map gives the shapes, the sounding spans the runs (notes/rounds/liquid-riffs.md)
provenance.character: long low holds a semitone or three apart, one high hold every four bars falling back into the floor; a clean sine
provenance.adopted: revision 2 (liquid-riffs-2, 10-08, notes/rounds/liquid-riffs-2.md): moved from the mined candidates into the liquid place's riff table, drawn by weight beside V's where the birds stand toward Tide, the calm. The pitch knots re-encoded in the loader's format since liquid-fix (each knot's note as an anchor, its offset as the residual: the same straight path, the register now chosen once); the phrase's knobs V's; the pair share 1 throughout where it read 0, so the riff plays V's body (the unequal pair, and the voice's third harmonic following it); the play block V's whole, its pairClock with it, as the place's way of playing a line. V's own rules stay V's: no afterKick, no double slides, no body accents, no press
